Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this series. The trophy is handed to Nicholas Pooran and he now joins his teammates to pose for some photos with that shining trophy. It is a perfect start for this young West Indies team under the leadership of Nicholas Pooran. They will be travelling next to Pakistan and the first ODI starts on Wednesday, 8th of June while Netherlands will take on England at home in an ODI series which starts on the 17th of June. However, you don’t have to wait for quality cricket action for that long just switch tabs and enjoy the beauty of Test cricket as England and New Zealand fight it out in Lord’s on the third day of the first Test match. Cheers!

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, says that he is very pleased to win with a new team and to win 3-0. Adds that he is happy with all the guys, everyone stuck to the plans, he is happy with the spinners as well. Mentions that Netherlands put on a great show, they stole the game away from them but they fought back well and capitalized on the moments. Says that the fans here have made the victory special for them.

Pieter Seelaar, the skipper of Netherlands, says that they played well in patches and adds that they had a proper chance in this game and a little bit of inexperience cost the game in the end. Tells that he is very disappointed to lose in this game and in the position they were at the end of 25 overs they should have won this game and they kind of deserved 10 points. Tells that Vikramjit Singh and Max O'Dowd played well throughout the series and they probably lost the game from the overs between 35 to 40.

Akeal Hosein is the PLAYER OF THE SERIES! He says that he is very pleased with his effort on this batting-friendly wicket. He credits Nicholas Pooran for his decision-making. Says that Pooran made the right changes at the right time. Concludes by saying that he is ready to put his hand up whenever the team requires it.

Kyle Mayers is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant knock of 120 off just 106 balls. He says that it was a good feeling, he always wanted to a century and he is really happy about it. Mentions that he tries to cherish the opportunities he gets and opening the batting was an opportunity and he is happy he made it count. Adds that it was his first time in Netherlands and his time here has been great. He hopes that he can open the batting along with Shai Hope in the near future as well.
Time for the presentation...

Netherlands will be ruining the fact that they did not manage to chase down this total despite having wickets in hand for the majority of this chase. However, this series will be a big learning curve for them as to how to build their innings in the middle overs and they certainly did better in the middle overs than they did in the previous two games. West Indies had two debutants in this game and both had a decent outing with Seales taking one wicket and Shermon Lewis finishing things off with three wickets. Overall, this series has turned out to be quite a productive one for West Indies and a major learning curve for the Dutch ahead of their series against England.

West Indies, riding on twin hundreds by Mayers and Brooks managed to put a big score on the board. The Dutch bowlers did well in the death overs with the ball but a chase of over 300 was always going to be tough. However, Netherlands started brightly with the bat and Vikramjit Singh and Max O'Dowd put on a 98 runs opening stand. Singh departed after scoring fifty in the 18th over and it was always going to be that middle phase that was going to decide the outcome of this game. Max O'Dowd who batted fluently in the first 15-16 overs suddenly went into his shell as the fear of losing wickets in clusters in middle overs was looming large. Musa Ahmad and Bas de Leede at the other ends played good run-a-ball innings but sadly they could not carry on and Max O'Dowd failed to up the ante. Max departed in the 43rd over on a score of 89 off 121 balls with his team needing 10 runs per over in the last 7 overs. Akeal Hosein was once again the star who got two big wickets of Max O'Dowd and Bas de Leede. Once, Max O'Dowd departed it was too much for other batters, and in the end, West Indies clinched this game by 20 runs.

West Indies have clinched the series by a 3-0 margin and Netherlands' search for a first ODI win against West Indies continues.  Have to say, though, that West Indies were made to toil hard in every game of this series and Netherlands have only improved as this series has progressed. However, West Indies have still managed to bag all 30 points of the ICC World Cup Super League from this series and they will be mighty pleased with the performance of this young team under Nicholas Pooran.

OUT! TAKEN! That's it! Shermon Lewis finishes things off! Three wickets on debut for Shermon Lewis! Another fuller ball, outside off. Vivian Kingma opens the face of his bat and slices it over backward point. Nkrumah Bonner there, runs backward and takes a sharp catch. West Indies win by 20 runs and clean sweep the series!
Commentary.Howout: c Nkrumah Bonner b Shermon Lewis

Commentary.Commentary: Vivian Kingma is the last man in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Shermon Lewis gets his second wicket of the match and Netherlands are now 9 down! Terrific stuff once again from Shermon Lewis. A fuller ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Ryan Klein swings his bat and tries to play across the line but he gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball goes on to hit the leg pole.
Fuller ball, pace on, outside off. Ryan Klein swings his bat at it but he misses.
A length ball, around middle. Ryan Klein drags it with the inner half of his bat towards deep square leg for a brace.
Ryan Klein is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Shermon Lewis gets his first ODI wicket as well! Brilliant bowling from the debutant. He drops it short, around middle and leg. Pieter Seelaar makes room and tries to pull this but he gets a top edge. The ball lobs up in the air and Shermon Lewis runs forward and takes an easy catch in the end. 23 needed off 5 balls!
Swing and a miss! Fuller, angling in down leg. Aryan Dutt makes room and swings his bat but he fails to get any connection. 23 needed off the last over!
A yorker now, around middle and leg. Pieter Seelaar digs it out back to the keeper. Shai Hope fumbles to stop the ball and the batters takes a quick single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries from! Poor from Hayden Walsh at the deep though! A length ball, around middle. Pieter Seelaar pulls this towards deep mid-wicket. Hayden Walsh runs to his right. However, he overruns and fails to stop the ball. Boundary.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fuller ball, pace on this time, outside off. Pieter Seelaar makes room and carves this towards deep cover for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! A slower ball, shorter one, around middle and off. Pieter Seelaar looks to pull this but he gets beaten.
Leg bye! A shorter ball, around middle and leg. Aryan Dutt looks to pull this but he misses. The ball hits him on his thigh pads n and rolls towards the leg side. Leg bye taken!
A length ball, around middle and off. Aryan Dutt looks to heave this on the leg side but he gets an inside edge on to his boot and towards the off side. A single taken!
Wide! Full, down the leg side. Aryan Dutt looks to flick but he misses. Wide called!
Aryan Dutt is the next man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Not what Netherlands needed at this stage, but they had to go for it! A length ball, off pace delivery, around middle. Logan van Beek flicks it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. They run the first one fast and come back for the second run. Hayden Walsh runs forward, collects the ball, and throws it towards Shai Hope. He grabs the ball quickly and whips the bails off. Logan van Beek puts in a dive but he falls juts short of his crease. West Indies have got their 7th wicket.
Shorter ball, slower one, outside off. Logan van Beek pulls it towards the fielder at long on. Two taken!
An off pace delivery, fuller, outside off. Pieter Seelaar opens the face of his bat and dabs it towards cover-point for a single.
A length ball, down the leg side. Logan van Beek flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Logan van Beek stands tall and pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Another slower bouncer, outside off. Pieter Seelaar looks to pull this one but he misses again. 40 needed off 18 balls.
Slower, shorter, outside off. Pieter Seelaar waits for it and tries to cut this away but he misses.
SIX! Pieter Seelaar gets off the mark in style! What a shot this is! A fuller ball, on middle. Pieter Seelaar makes room ad dispatches this one straight down the ground for a biggie.
Back of a length, around middle. Logan van Beek pushes it down to long on for a biggie.
Pieter Seelaar is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Jayden Seales has his maiden ODI wicket! Netherlands are in trouble now! Jayden Seales drops it short, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru makes room and looks to pull this but the ball goes off the top edge and flies high towards the keeper. Shai Hope runs forward and pouches it safely. 47 needed 22 balls now.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Jayden Seales

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, fuller ball. Teja Nidamanuru slices it over extra-cover for two runs.
Bye! A fuller one, outside off. Teja Nidamanuru looks to reverse-sweep this but he misses. The ball deflects off the keeper's glove towards short third man and the batters steal in a bye.
Flatter, shorter, around middle. Logan van Beek knocks it down to long on for a single.
Excellent running once again! Fuller ball, on the pads. Logan van Beek flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace. Logan van Beek dives in to make his ground.
Quicker, full, around off. Teja Nidamanuru tonks it towards long off. Only a single this time.
Tosses it up, fuller ball, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru works it away wide of long on and takes two runs. This is good running!
Wide! Wide of off. Teja Nidamanuru leaves it alone. Wide called!

Overthrows! A loopy ball, very full, around middle. Logan van Beek steps down the pitch and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Kyle Mayers scores a direct hit at the keeper's end. The ball deflects off the stumps and goes towards third man two more taken!
On a length, on off. Logan van Beek pushes it to mid off for a single. 60 needed from 30 balls now!
Beaten! Lands on a length, around off and nips back in. Logan van Beek looks to defend but is beaten. Luckily for him, the ball goes just over the off pole.
A fullish delivery, on middle. Teja Nidamanuru heaves it off the inside half of his blade to fine leg for a single.
On a length, around leg. Logan van Beek works it to fine leg for a single.

On a length and angling into middle. Teja Nidamanuru looks to work it towards the leg side. However, he gets the inside edge onto his pads and a run is taken as the ball rolls towards the off side. There is an appeal for an LBW as well but there is clearly bat involved there.
A low full toss on middle. Logan van Beek pushes it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off. Logan van Beek drives it to long off for a single.

NOT OUT! Tossed up on middle and it is a googly that hits Logan van Beek on his front foot as he tries to defend it. There is an appeal but the umpire says no. West Indies review but the Ball Tracking shows that the ball is going over the stumps. The original decision stays, Logan van Beek will continue.
Logan van Beek comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another big wicket and this Dutch innings seems to be going nowhere now! The pressure was building and Scott Edwards needed to do something different. He tries to go for the reverse-sweep to this full ball, on off. However, it ends up lopping up in the air towards short third man and Shermon Lewis takes an easy catch there.
Commentary.Howout: c Shermon Lewis b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: A flatter delivery on off. Teja Nidamanuru defends it towards the off side for a single.
Fuller and around off. Scott Edwards gets across and fails to connect the sweep properly. However, it is enough to take a single towards short fine leg.
Walsh goes full on middle. Scott Edwards sweeps it to deep square leg for a couple.
Teja Nidamanuru walks out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED! Akeal Hosein strikes and this is a big blow for Netherlands! Max O'Dowd departs! Akeal Hosein nicely tosses this up, on middle. Max O'Dowd senses an opportunity to go inside out and makes room. Looks for a lofted drive but misses it as the ball turns just a bit. It shatters the stumps and Max O'Dowd has to walk back disappointed. 70 needed now from 42 balls. Netherlands needed their set opener to bat till the end.
This is full on leg. Scott Edwards makes room and slices it over covers for a single.
Angling into middle. Scott Edwards pushes it to the leg side and looks for a single but is sent back in time.
FOUR! Teriffic shot from Scott Edwards! A half-tracker on off. Scott Edwards pulls it hard towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Tossed up on off. Scott Edwards sweeps it to deep square leg for a couple.
Angling into middle. Max O'Dowd works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Akeal Hosein (9-1-44-1) comes back to bowl his final over.
Shorter and outside off. Max O'Dowd cuts it to deep point for a single. 78 needed now from 48 balls!
A fuller delivery on middle. Max O'Dowd hits in the gap between long on and deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
A flatter one on middle. Scott Edwards clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Max O'Dowd drives it to sweeeper cover for a single.

FOUR! Another boundary and Max O'Dowd has now two boundaries of consecutive deliveries! Tossed up, on off. Max O'Dowd reverse-sweeps and does it very fine and the ball races away towards the third man boundary. Walsh meanwhile appeals for an LBW but the umpire says it is bat first.
Tossed up on off. Scott Edwards sweeps it to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Outside edge and Max O'Dowd finally gets a boundary! It is full and outside off. Max O'Dowd looks to drive it away towards the off side. He gets a thick outside edge and the ball races away towards the third man fence.
Just a single again! Short ball angling into off. Scott Edwards pulls but gets the top edge this time. It goes off the bounce to King at fine leg. Single taken.
Back of a length, on off. Max O'Dowd mistimes his pull shot to long on for a single.
Length delivery, outside off. Scott Edwards cuts it to deep point for a single. Five overs since the last boundary!
On a length, on off. Scott Edwards heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Lands on a length, around off. Max O'Dowd drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning.
Tosses this up, outside off. Scott Edwards tries to sweep this from outside off but he misses. Terrific over from Hayden Walsh!
Loopy ball, fuller one, around middle. Scott Edwards gets down and looks to reverse-sweep this but he misses and gets hit on his pad. There was an appeal for LBW, but not given. Impact was outside.
Tosses it up, fuller, outside off. Scott Edwards sweeps it towards the fielder at short fine leg.
A leg-breaker now, around middle. Scott Edwards pushes it back to the bowler.
Leg bye! Darting it on the pads, fullish ball. Max O'Dowd looks to flick this but he misses. The ball goes off his pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken!
Tosses it up, fuller now, around middle and off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out towards the off-side.
Hayden Walsh (6-0-29-1) is back into the attack.
Back of a length, around middle. Max O'Dowd drags it with the inner half of his bat towards deep square leg for a single.
On a length, around middle and leg. Scott Edwards tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Slower ball now, shortish ball, around off. Scott Edwards taps it towards cover.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
On a length, around middle. Max O'Dowd pushes it back to the bowler.

Quick single! A shorter ball, around middle. Scott Edwards taps it towards mid-wicket and sets off to the other end. The fielder there collects the ball and throws it at the non-strikers end but he misses.

A shout for LBW but not given! A shorter ball, this one comes in with the angle. Max O'Dowd hangs back and tries to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads. That was probably too high. A maiden wicket over from Akeal Hosein!
Shorter ball, around middle and off. Max O'Dowd pushes it back to the bowler.
Scott Edwards is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Another wicket at the perfect time for West Indies! It's Akeal Hosein this time who grabs the wicket and sends Bas de Leede back to the hut. A fuller ball, around off. Bas de Leede once again, gets down on his knee and tries to sweep it. But the ball goes off the top edge towards short fine leg. Shermon Lewis takes a dolly there.
Commentary.Howout: c Shermon Lewis b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, full again. Bas de Leede shuffles across and tries to sweep this but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Shorter ball, around middle. Bas de Leede makes room and pushes it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, very full, around off. Bas de Leede looks to sweep this but he misses.
Akeal Hosein will continue. He has been wicketless so far in his 8 overs.
Outside off now, length delivery. Max O'Dowd dabs it towards point. No run there! 11 runs off the over!
Another length delivery, angling in around middle. Bas de Leede works it away past mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd dabs it towards point for a single.
Angling in on a length, on the pads. Bas de Leede tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Wide of off this time, fuller ball. Bas de Leede slices it past point. The fielder from third man runs to his right, and dives but fails to stop the ball. Boundary! Good start to the over for Netherlands!
FOUR! Lovely shot! A length ball, outside off. Bas de Leede shimmies down the track and smashes it over extra-cover for a boundary.
Drifting in, on the pads. Max O'Dowd clips it towards mid-wicket.
Tosses it up, fuller ball, around middle. Bas de Leede makes room and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Fullish ball, quicker, around middle. Max O'Dowd makes room and drives it towards cover-point for a single.
Spinning away, shortish ball, around middle. Max O'Dowd taps it towards cover.
Quicker, fuller, around middle. Bas de Leede sweeps it towards short fine leg for a single.
Quicker, shorter, around middle. Max O'Dowd flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Another dot to end the over and 118 needed now from 90 balls! Fullish length, on off. Bas de Leede drives it straight to the cover fielder.
A low full toss on off. Bas de Leede pushes it back to the bowler.
WIDE! It is full and down the leg side. Bas de Leede looks to clip it but misses.
SIX! Bas de Leede clears the fence this time and Netherlands need some of these hits now. A short ball, outside off. Bas de Leede stays back and slaps it straight down the ground for a maximum.
WIDE! Slower and full delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede leaves it alone.
Full and around off. Max O'Dowd drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish length, outside off. Bas de Leede drives away from his body. He gets the thick outside edge of his blade and a single is taken towards third man.
Back of a length and angling into the body. Max O'Dowd guides it towards fine leg for a single.

DRINKS! Netherlands have kept their wickets intact, but runs have dried up a bit. They are still very much in the contest with the required run rate in control. Max O'Dowd needs to step on the gas and try to start scoring at a brisk rate to release the pressure towards the end. If West Indies get a couple of wickets here they will certainly be on top.
On the shorter side, around off. Max O'Dowd punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Walsh pushes it quicker and around off. Bas de Leede steers it towards third man for a single.
Quicker and slightly shorter outside off. Max O'Dowd cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Max O'Dowd drives it to covers.
Tossed up, around off. Bas de Leede gets across and sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Darted on middle and leg. Max O'Dowd works it to square leg for a single.
Short and outside off. Max O'Dowd pulls it wide of mid on for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Bas de Leede pushes it to covers for a single.
On a length, around off. Max O'Dowd steers it towards third man for a single.
A fullish delivery, around off. Max O'Dowd drives it back to the bowler.
Full delivery on off. Max O'Dowd looks to drive but gets the inside edge onto his pads.

NOT OUT! Lands on a length, on off and nips back in sharply. Max O'Dowd looks to defend but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards the keeper. There is an appeal for an LBW but the umpire says no. West Indies take the review. However, the Ball Tracking shows that it is missing stumps. So Max O'Dowd will continue.
Max O'Dowd has done well to survive but he is struggling here to find the boundary. He got his 50 off 57 balls but since then it's been tough for him. However, Netherlands need him to be patient.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Bas de Leede looks to cut but misses.
Short ball on middle. Max O'Dowd pulls it aerially but short of the deep square leg fielder. A single taken.
Darts it on middle. Max O'Dowd looks to push but gets the inside half of his blade and it goes towards short mid-wicket.
WIDE! Fuller and outside off. Max O'Dowd leaves it alone.
Spears it around leg and slightly short. Max O'Dowd looks to cut but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal. However, it is going down leg.
Slower in the air and fuller on off. Max O'Dowd pushes it towards the off side.
A googly on middle. Max O'Dowd works it to short mid-wicket.
Seales lands it on a length, on off. Bas de Leede blocks it from his crease.
WIDE! Jayden Seales tries a short ball. It ends up being too high and Bas de Leede lets it go.
A fuller delivery on middle. Max O'Dowd drives it left of mid on but the fielder dives and stops it. Just a single.
Beaten! Shortish length again and outside off. Max O'Dowd tries to cut it but misses.
On the shorter side, outside off. Bas de Leede cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish length, on middle. Bas de Leede works it off the inside half of his blade to short mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
Loopy ball now, full, outside off. Bas de Leede presses forward and drives it towards sweeper cover for a single. End of a successful over from Hayden Walsh!
Shorter ball, around middle and off. Max O'Dowd punches it off the back foot down to long off for a single.
Quicker, shorter, around middle. Bas de Leede works it away towards mid-wicket for  single.
Bas de Leede walks in at number 4.

OUT! LBW! Hayden Walsh strikes and breaks the partnership! West Indies have got a wicket and at the right time, Netherlands were running away with it. A loopy ball, slower through the air, full and straight. Musa Ahmad comes forward and yorks himself. He tries to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his front pad.A huge appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his finger. That's plump!
Loopy ball, outside off, full in length. Musa Ahmad blocks it out.

TWO BYES! A fuller ball, tosses it up, outside off. Musa Ahmad leans to drive but he misses. Shai Hope misses it as well. The ball goes through his legs towards third man and the batters pick up two runs.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Max O'Dowd drives it wide of the sweeper cover fielder for a brace. Good running!
Fullish delivery, around off. Musa Ahmad drives it past mid off for a quick single.
Back of a length, around middle. Musa Ahmad defends it out.
FOUR! This time on the off side! Another shorter ball, wide of off. Musa Ahmad slashes it past point for a boundary.
On a length, around middle and leg. Musa Ahmad blocks it out towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Great start to the over! Jayden Seales drops it short, around middle. Musa Ahmad swivels and pulls it in the gap between fine leg and deep square leg for a boundary.
Jayden Seales is back on.
Short this time, width on offer. Musa Ahmad cuts it past point for a single.
Quick single! Pitches it up, full in length. Max O'Dowd taps it towards cover and takes a quick single.
Quicker now, on middle. Musa Ahmad gets down on his knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Floats it up, very full, around middle. Musa Ahmad pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Loopy ball, full again, down the leg side. Musa Ahmad gets down once again, and sweeps it fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Musa Ahmad looks to sweep this again, but he misses. Wide called!
Tosses it up, full, around off. Musa Ahmad gets low and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Two taken!
Fuller ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd drives it back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery, very full, around middle. Musa Ahmad works it down to long on for a single.
Outside off, fuller ball. Musa Ahmad guides towards third man for a couple of runs.
Fuller, down leg this time. Musa Ahmad gets low and scoops it behind the keeper. Two taken!
Flighted delivery, full, outside off. Max O'Dowd drives it towards cover for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Max O'Dowd sweeps it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Boundary off the last ball ruins a good over from Hayden Walsh! A shorter one, outside off. Musa Ahmad hangs back and cuts it past short third man for a boundary.
Tosses it up, a low full toss, on middle. Musa Ahmad pushes it back to the bowler.
Another loopy ball, full again, on middle. Musa Ahmad blocks it out off the front foot.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Musa Ahmad defends it out.
Tad shorter now, around middle. Max O'Dowd knocks it down to long on for a single.
A shorter ball, googly now, around middle. Max O'Dowd pushes it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side on middle. Max O'Dowd tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 179 needed from 150 balls!
Loopy delivery on off. Max O'Dowd looks to drive but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Half-tracker on middle. Musa Ahmad pulls it to deep backward square leg for just a single this time.
Nicely tossed up on middle. Musa Ahmad sweeps it to deep backward square leg and comes back for two.
Slower in the air on middle. Musa Ahmad defends it out.
Tossed up, outside off. Max O'Dowd drives it to covers. The fielder in the ring does well to stop it with a dive. Single taken.
Time for some more spin as Nkrumah Bonner comes to bowl now.
On the shorter side, around off. Musa Ahmad pulls it off the inside half of his blade towards deep backward square leg for a couple.
Flatter delivery on off. Musa Ahmad solidly blocks it.

Slower in the air, on off and fuller. Musa Ahmad looks to work it towards the leg side. He is early on the shot and gets the outside edge of his blade. The ball goes towards the third man region and the batters run two.
Quicker one on off. Musa Ahmad defends it off the back foot.
Goes fuller and slower on off. Musa Ahmad drives it to covers.
Walsh starts off with a quicker delivery and slightly short, around off. Musa Ahmad looks to cut it but mistimes it.
Hayden Walsh comes into the attack now.
This is a bit short on off. Max O'Dowd goes back and defends it.
Slower in the air, on middle. Max O'Dowd blocks it off the front foot.
A flatter and quicker one on off. Musa Ahmad chops it square off the wicket on the off side for a single.
A fuller one on middle. Max O'Dowd drives it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery around off. Musa Ahmad pushes it to point for a single.
FOUR! Boundary to start the over and much-needed one! Short and wide, outside off. Musa Ahmad cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Maiden over! On a length, on off. Max O'Dowd pushes it towards the leg side. This will help Windies, the pressure of dots ball cam force one of these batters to take risk.
Five dots in a row! Lands on a length, on off. No room for the batter to work with and Max O'Dowd just defends it.
Around off and same length. Max O'Dowd pushes it towards the off side.
Lands on a length, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
On the stumps and full again. Max O'Dowd drives again and this time to mid on.
A fullish length, outside off. Max O'Dowd drives it towards covers.
Darted on middle. Musa Ahmad works it to mid-wicket.
This is full and outside off. Max O'Dowd drives it through covers for a single.
Straighter line again and Max O'Dowd with a defensive shot again.
Pushed quicker on middle and Max O'Dowd is happy to block it off.
A flatter one on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it off the front foot.

FOUR! Good shot and this has been Max O'Dowd's most fluent innings in this series, fifty for the prolific opener! Fuller delivery, outside off. Max O'Dowd leans forward and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Darting it on the pads, on a length. Max O'Dowd tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Beaten! Good ball by Kyle Mayers! Slower now, on a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd hangs back and tries to guide it towards third man but he misses.
Wide! Down the leg side, shorter ball. Max O'Dowd looks to pull this but he misses. Wide called!
Length ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd cuts it to point. No run there!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Musa Ahmad taps it with soft hands towards cover and scampers across to the other end. There was a throw at the bowler's end but no harm done.
Another fuller ball, angles it in again, around middle. Musa Ahmad pushes it towards mid on.
Angling in around the pads, on a fuller length. Max O'Dowd tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Musa Ahmad defends it out.
Quicker, shorter, flatter, around off. Max O'Dowd pushes it wide of mid off and takes a single.
Tosses this one up, fuller in length, on the pads. Max O'Dowd clips it through square leg for a brace.
Quicker, this one comes in with the arm, around middle. Max O'Dowd pushes it back to Akeal Hosein.
Another shorter ball from 'round the wicket, around middle. Max O'Dowd tucks it through fine leg. Two taken!
A shorter ball, around middle, from 'round the wicket. Musa Ahmad knocks it down to mid on for a quick single.
Tad shorter now, angling in on the body. Musa Ahmad flicks it towards deep square leg. Single taken!
On a length now, angling in around middle and leg. Musa Ahmad blocks it out.
A similar delivery! Fullish ball, around middle. Musa Ahmad drives it towards mid on.
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Musa Ahmad pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
A length ball, around off. Musa Ahmad leans forward and defends it out.
Musa Ahmad is the next man in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! West Indies have struck on the first ball after drinks! Kyle Mayers gets rid of Vikramjit Singh. A peach of a delivery. A length ball, tailing back in around middle. Vikramjit Singh looks to block this but he gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball sneaks in the gap between bat and pad and goes on to hit the stumps. Much-needed wicket for West Indies!

DRINKS! This has been an excellent start from the Dutch. Just what the doctor ordered but the real test will be in these coming middle overs. We have seen them giving away the advantage quite a few times in this phase and let's see how they go about their business today. West Indies would know that couple of wickets here and they can control this game. Kyle Mayers will continue with the ball for West Indies. Can he provide the breakthrough?
This one comes in with the angle, shortish ball, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd stays in his crease and blocks it out towards the leg side.
Loopy ball, full, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd leans and blocks it out.
Back of a length, around off. Max O'Dowd pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Tosses it up, fuller, around middle. Vikramjit Singh sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Tad fuller, outside off. Max O'Dowd makes room and drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Slower through the air, shorter ball, around middle. Max O'Dowd defends it out back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Vikramjit Singh tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Another length ball, angling it on the pads. Max O'Dowd tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd blocks it out back to the bowler.
Length ball, darting it on the thigh pads. Vikramjit Singh tucks it towards deep square leg and rotates the strike.
Angling this time, on a length, around middle. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Vikramjit Singh makes room and pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Angling into middle, provides no room once again and Max O'Dowd works it towards short mid-wicket.
Akeal Hosein pushes this one quicker again, on off. Max O'Dowd is happy to defend this one too.
Straighter line again and quicker. Max O'Dowd plays it back to the bowler.
A flatter one on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.

FIFTY for Vikramjit Singh! His maiden ODI fifty. He got out in 40s in the first two games but has made sure that he gets to the landmark this time. A fuller delivery on middle. Singh works it to deep square leg for a single.
Drifting on the leg stump. Max O'Dowd tucks it fine and takes three runs as the fielder cuts it off near the fence.
Fullish delivery on off. Max O'Dowd drives it to long on and takes a single. 221 runs more needed off 216 balls!
Mayers continues to bowl length delivery. It is on off and Max O'Dowd turns it towards short mid-wicket.
On a length again and around off. Max O'Dowd pushes it to point.
Serves a length delivery on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it comfortably.
Two more to the total here. A full delivery on the pads. Max O'Dowd flicks it towards deep backward square leg for a couple.
Lands on a length, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it onto the turf.
Kyle Mayers (2-0-19-0) comes back into the attack.

Pushed quicker and slightly shorter on off. Max O'Dowd punches it to sweeper cover for a single. At the end of 13 overs, West Indies were 61-1, so Netherlands are way ahead. However, they have struggled in the middle overs and need to bat better today.
Angling into leg. Singh works it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Vikramjit Singh is taking on Akeal Hosein here! Tossed up on off. Singh skips down the track and smashes it straight down the ground for a boundary.
A flatter delivery on middle. Singh works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Great use of his feet! Beautiful shot! A fuller one, around middle. Vikramjit Singh dances down the track and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. He moves on to 44 with that!
A shorter ball, spinning in, around middle. Vikramjit Singh pushes it back to the bowler.
Akeal Hosein comes back to bowl. He went for 6 runs in his first over.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short and wide outside off. Max O'Dowd cuts it through point for a boundary.
Lands on a length and it is around off. Max O'Dowd punches it towards backward point.
A fuller delivery on off. Max O'Dowd clips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Hits the length hard again, around off. Max O'Dowd dabs it towards point.
WIDE! It is banged short on off. Max O'Dowd lets it go and a wide is signalled as it is too high.
On a length, around off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
A short ball, around off. Max O'Dowd ducks under it.
WIDE! Shorter length and down the leg side. Max O'Dowd leaves it alone.
Jayden Seales (3-0-11-0) comes back into the attack.
On a length and angling into middle. Singh works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nicely played! Lands on a length, around off. Singh opens the face of his blade smartly and guides it towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Drifting on the pads again. Max O'Dowd works it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Max O'Dowd looks to clip it but misses.
Fullish length, outside off. Singh drives it to sweeper cover for another single.
On a length, on middle. Max O'Dowd works it to fine leg for a single.
Starts off with a full delivery, outside off. Singh drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, it is Keacy Carty who comes onto bowl now.
Outside off, on a good length. Vikramjit Singh chops it towards deep backward point for a single. Netherlands are 58 for 0 at the end of Powerplay 1!
Beaten! A length ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh hangs back and tries to push this on the off side but he misses.

Dropped! A fuller ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh presses forward and drives it uppishly towards cover. Shamarh Brooks there jumps to his right, and gets both his hands to the ball, but he fails to hold on to it. Could prove to be costly.
Shorter ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh looks to cut this away but he gets an under edge back onto the deck.
FOUR! Vikramjit Singh is looking in some fine touch here! Another beautiful shot from him! Fuller ball, around off. Vikramjit Singh omes forward and drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Angling in, on the pads, fuller ball. Max O'Dowd flicks it past square leg. Single taken!
Tad shorter, outside off. Vikramjit Singh pushes it off the back foot through cover for a brace.
Around middle, tad shorter. Max O'Dowd drags it with the inner half of his bat towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Terrific shot! A fuller ball, around off. Max O'Dowd shimmies down the track and drives it firmly past cover for a boundary.
A length ball, around middle and leg. Vikramjit Singh backs away and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh pushes it towards mid off.

Mix-up...but no harm done! A length ball, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd turns it down to to square leg. A miscommunication in the middle, but a misfield allows the batters to take a single at the end.
FOUR! This time it's in the gap! Shortish ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh gets on top of the bounce and slaps it past cover for a boundary. Top shot!
Fuller ball, around off. Vikramjit Singh drives firmly but straight to the fielder at mid off. Fails to find the gap this time as well.
Another pitched up delivery, wide of off. Vikramjit Singh presses forward and drives it towards cover-point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh leaans to drive but the ball goes off the inside edge back onto his thigh pads.
Tad fuller, tailing back in around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Pitches it up, outside off. Max O'Dowd drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Angling in around middle and leg, length delivery. Vikramjit Singh backs away and taps it towards cover-point.
Another length delivery, outside off. Vikramjit Singh defends it out towards cover once again.
Angling in on a length, around middle and off. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out towards cover.
SIX! BANG! Back of a length, around off. Vikramjit Singh pulls this high over long on for a biggie. Lovely shot! 10 runs off the first three balls!
On a length, around off. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out.
FOUR! Vikramjit Singh greets Kyle Mayers with a boundary. A short ball, width on offer. Vikramjit Singh hangs back and slashes it over point for a boundary.
Kyle Mayers comes into the attack now.
Around off, shortish ball. Max O'Dowd looks to cut this away but he gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Back of a length, outside off, at 130 clicks. Max O'Dowd dabs it towards point.
Tighter line now, around off, shortish ball. Max O'Dowd defends it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Nicely done! Effortless from Max O'Dowd! Tad shorter, outside off. Max O'Dowd stays in his crease, opens the face of his bat and guides it down the short third man for a boundary.
Beaten this time! Pulled his length back a tad, outside off, at around 134 clicks. Max O'Dowd looks to have a push at it but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
A length ball, around middle and off. Vikramjit Singh drives it wide of mid off and takes a single.
On a length, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it from his crease.
A full delivery on off. Singh heaves it through mid-wicket and the batters run three as the fielder cuts it off. Good running!
Misfield allows a couple this time! Fullish length, outside off. Singh drives it straight to Walsh at point. He misfields and the batters run two.
Good short delivery! Around off and angling into the batter. Singh sways away from the line of the ball.
On a length, on off at 140 kph. Singh drives it but finds the mid off fielder.
Fullish delivery shaping into middle. Max O'Dowd looks to drive but gets the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Slightly short and outside off. Singh tries to cut it but misses.
Back of a length, on off. Singh blocks it out.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Tad full but not enough full to call it a half-volley. However, Singh drives and drives it well past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Singh punches it to covers.
Bit full this time, close to off. Singh tries to drive without much foot movement and ends up hitting it off the inside half of his blade.
Starts with a shortish length, around off. Singh punches it through covers for a couple.
Shermon Lewis comes into the attack.
Back of a length and same line again. Max O'Dowd punches it to cover-point.
Tad shorter again, around off. Max O'Dowd pushes it towards the off side.
Back of a length, around off. Max O'Dowd dabs it towards point.
Pitches it on a good length and outside off. Max O'Dowd defends it off the middle of his blade.
Pulls his length back on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
FOUR! Good shot, Max O'Dowd has started positively today! A full delivery on middle. Max O'Dowd drives it past mid on for a boundary.
Angling on leg and quicker, Singh looks to clip it away but misses and the ball hits his thigh pad.
This is flatter and on off again. Singh pushes it towards the off side.
Fuller, around off. Singh drives it to covers.
Slower in the air, on off. Singh gets forward and defends it.
WIDE! Darted down the leg side. Singh looks to pull it but misses.
Fuller ball, on off. Max O'Dowd pushes it to covers for a single.

FOUR! Akeal Hosein is greeted with a boundary here! Overpitched outside off. Max O'Dowd leans forward and drives it through extra-cover. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and dives but fails to stop it.
Time for spin early on for West Indies! Akeal Hosein comes into the attack.
Play and a miss! Just a wide and all dots after that. Angled across the batter and it lands on a length, outside off. Singh looks to cut but misses.
Serves a length delivery, close to off. Singh defends it off the inside half of his blade.
Tad shorter and outside off. Singh looks to cut it but misses. Some extra bounce as well.
Pitches it on a length again, on middle. Singh works it towards mid-wicket.

Lovely delivery! This is his strength, he can seam and swing the ball both ways. This is angled across the batter. Lands on a good length and around off. Singh looks to defend but the ball seams away and beats the outside edge of his blade.
On the money this time, a length delivery, on off. Singh defends it towards the off side.
WIDE! Jayden Seales starts his ODI career with a wide! It is full and way outside off. Singh leaves it alone.
